newsitem.title: CANADA: Circo Craft recommends HMTF offer.
newsitem.headline: Circo Craft recommends HMTF offer.

text.p: Circo Craft Co Inc said on Friday its board of directors had recommended to shareholders that they accept the C$11.00 a share cash offer made by HMTF Canada Acquisition Inc, sponsored by Hicks, Muse, Tate and Furst Inc.
Circo Craft said the board recommended shareholders tender their shares to the offer unless a higher offer is before it expires on September 28.
HMTF was formed by an investment fund sponsored by Hicks, Muse, Tate and Furst, a leading private investment firm based in Dallas, for the purpose of acquiring Circo Craft.

The Circo Craft board said it was notified by its president, chief executive and co-founder Hans Muhlegg that he intends to accept the offer and will tender his common shares unless a higher offer is made before expiry date.
Muhlegg holds 24.3 percent of the outstanding shares of Circo Craft.
Circo Craft said all its other directors and senior executives also decided to tender their shares to the offer.
